UPDATED STATUS OF EO-PAIR:
The current standard (circa February 2024) for EO-pair solves the pair into the back slot and then does pair-solved EO.
The technique of doing pair-creation followed by eo-pair is an older style. Depending on the particular algs you use and your lookahead capabilities, this may or may not be slightly faster at the cost of learning an additional 128 algs. (One estimate says pair-creation→EO-pair saves ≈0.3 moves over the current standard on average)
It is also possible to solve the pair in the front right, although this is not recommended for most solves as it would require learning an additional 116 LXS algs and there are more blind spots during EO and LXS.
